canvasWords.missing: The function follows the word cache of Blink, not UAX #29. Blink ends a word only at a space, a tab, a zero width space or a CJK word start. So the boundaries of UAX #29 between letters, digits and punctuation are not there.
canvasWords.extra: Each space is a word alone, and a CJK or emoji character starts a word. UAX #29 keeps a mark or a joiner with the character before it, so the function has a boundary that the file does not have.
canvasWords.both: The test has the 2 differences of the classes missing and extra at different places.
